title: AI for Data Analysis: Excel, Google Sheets & Power BI
subtitle: Use ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot and Gemini to write formulas, clean data, build MIS reports and Power BI dashboards — and verify every number.
description:
This course is for MIS executives, accountants, operations and sales analysts, MBA students and anyone in India whose work runs on spreadsheets. If you spend evenings fighting VLOOKUPs, rebuilding the same monthly report, or wondering whether you can trust an AI-generated total, this course is built for you.

You will learn to use AI assistants as a spreadsheet co-pilot: describing your sheet so you get correct XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, INDEX-MATCH, IF, text and date formulas the first time; understanding and repairing inherited formulas; cleaning messy data with duplicates, name variants and text dates; and summarising it with pivot tables. You will then upload data to ChatGPT or Claude for analysis, use Copilot in Excel and Gemini in Sheets, and move into Power BI with DAX measures explained in plain English.

Every example uses realistic Indian data — a Jaipur retailer's GST-inclusive sales, a Bengaluru startup's leads sheet, a Nagpur distributor's branch MIS — and every lesson ends with a hands-on exercise. A strong thread runs throughout: data privacy (never uploading PAN or Aadhaar, masking customer data) and verification, so the numbers you present are numbers you can defend.

By the end you will have four portfolio projects: a cleaned and analysed 1,000-row sales dataset, a refreshable pivot-based monthly MIS report, a one-page dashboard in Power BI or Google Sheets, and a five-insight executive summary.

Accountants and CA-firm staff working with sales registers and expense data
